lines.zh: 长船搁浅了，我踩着浪过来。
lines.en: The longship grounded; I come through the surf.

lines.zh: 矛杆当拐杖，冰上不打滑。
lines.en: The spear shaft is my staff on the ice.

lines.zh: 盾背在背后，晃得很有节奏。
lines.en: The shield on my back sways in rhythm.

lines.zh: 北风割着脸，我照样往前。
lines.en: The north wind cuts my face; I press on.

lines.zh: 靴里灌满海水，冷得钻心。
lines.en: Seawater in my boots, cold to the marrow.

lines.zh: 我走路像还在甲板上打晃。
lines.en: I still walk as if swaying on a deck.

lines.zh: 雪没到膝盖，拔脚很费劲。
lines.en: Snow to my knees makes each step a fight.

lines.zh: 我踩着前人的脚印过雪原。
lines.en: I cross the snowfield in footprints already there.

lines.zh: 闻到炊烟了，脚就快起来。
lines.en: Smelling hearth smoke, my feet speed up.

lines.zh: 这段路走完，就烤鱼喝酒。
lines.en: One more stretch, then fish and ale.

lines.zh: 风大，我把胡须上的冰掰掉。
lines.en: The wind is strong; I snap ice from my beard.

lines.zh: 我用石头磨矛尖，慢慢来。
lines.en: I hone the spear point on a stone, slowly.
That crack across my shield is still there.
A raven sits in the tree; I let it be.
Too quiet here — not like the north.
I work out which way the sea lies.

lines.zh: 手心有茧，是划桨划出来的。
lines.en: These calluses came from the oars.

lines.zh: 我把湿透的羊毛拧了一把。
lines.en: I wring out the soaked wool.
When the snow stops, I light a fire.

lines.zh: 我对着天空小声念了句祷词。
lines.en: I mutter a prayer to the sky.
My flask is empty, and so is my mood.
I carve a mark into the snow.

lines.zh: 这块地没有礁石，不习惯。
lines.en: No reefs here — I am not used to it.

lines.zh: 手指冻僵了，握不住刀柄。
lines.en: My fingers are numb around the hilt.

lines.zh: 我把盾翻过来，检查绑带。
lines.en: I flip the shield and check its straps.
I stand straight as a mast.

lines.zh: 你是本地人？还是落难的？
lines.en: Are you from here, or shipwrecked?
Your hands have never held an oar.
I am only looking. Do not misunderstand.
Whose land is this? Anyone claim it?
I cannot read your stance.
Will you drink with me?

lines.zh: 我皱眉，你的鞋太干净了。
lines.en: I frown — your boots are too clean.
Do not stand on the spear side.

lines.zh: 我抬下巴，示意你走近点。
lines.en: I lift my chin for you to come closer.
You talk like a southerner.
The shield caught it; my arm still numbs.
Blood drips into the snow, sharp red.
I spit blood.
I will remember that blow.
I straighten up. I do not kneel.
A rib feels broken.
I laugh, and it sounds ugly.

lines.zh: 还没到吟唱我名字的时候。
lines.en: It is not yet time to sing my name.
Ale? Let me smell it first.
Did you catch this fish yourself?
I can trade salt for it.
My belly has been empty three days.
Not too much — I do not like debts.
Mead would be better.

lines.zh: 我把矛靠在肩上，腾出手。
lines.en: I lean the spear on my shoulder and free a hand.
That smell is my home hearth.
I take a bite and chew slowly.
I will remember this kindness.
Make way; my shield has no eyes.
You walked into the spear shaft. Hurts, yes?
A shove of my shoulder sends you back.
Hard to stand in snow — do not blame me.
My shield is oak, and heavy.
Shove again and the spear comes up.

lines.zh: 两人挤在雪道上，都不方便。
lines.en: Two of us on a snow path suits no one.
Do not touch the face of my shield.
A woman waits for me at home.
In the north this calls for a feast.
When the ship is repaired.
I honor the gods first, then speak of this.
Soft words are not my craft.
I plant the spear in the snow and shake my head.
This must be told to the clan.
The ale is not finished yet.
I laugh, then turn away.
My heart holds only sea and fire.
This bronze ring has a tale behind it.
I bend down; my shield knocks the ground.
Whose flint is this? Mine now.
I tuck it into my belt.
A scrap of cloth shows through the snow.

lines.zh: 捡东西前我先看了看四周。
lines.en: I check around before picking it up.
This can patch my sail.
I rub the ice off it.

lines.zh: 海送来什么，我就收什么。
lines.en: What the sea gives, I take.
Stowed. Do not let it fall again.
The point comes up — you had best explain.
I have chosen you.

lines.zh: 你惹到了不该惹的船队。
lines.en: You stirred the wrong crew.
Do not turn your back to me.
This fight will be told at home.

lines.zh: 我的手心已经开始出汗。
lines.en: My palms are already damp.
Try running, if you like.
I level the point and wait for you to enter reach.
Iron in the air — I know that smell.
I stamp my feet firm in the snow.
The gods are watching; I stand.

lines.zh: 你站的地方，正合我的矛长。
lines.en: You stand exactly at spear's reach.
I laugh once. It is not friendly.

lines.zh: 我要你的东西，不要你的命。
lines.en: I want your goods, not your life.

lines.zh: 我不喊叫，喊叫浪费力气。
lines.en: I will not shout — shouting wastes breath.

lines.zh: 你走一步，我的矛就进一寸。
lines.en: One step from you is one inch of my spear.
I am measuring the distance to you.
The point stays still; I move first.
You feint left and right; I turn with you.
The snow slows both our feet.

lines.zh: 我等你出手，先出手的人先露破绽。
lines.en: I wait — the first to strike shows the gap.
Frost has formed on my shield rim.

lines.zh: 你的肩在抖，是冷还是怕？
lines.en: Your shoulder trembles — cold, or fear?
I raise the shield half an inch.
You are looking for a way out.
No one runs far on this snow path.
My spear is longer than your reach.

lines.zh: 矛尖对着你的胸口，别动。
lines.en: My spear tip is at your chest. Do not move.

lines.zh: 冰面反光，我不看你的眼。
lines.en: The glare off the ice; I do not read your eyes.
You cracked a sheet of ice.
I settle my weight on my back foot.
The sea wind comes at your back.
No hurry — the snow will stiffen you.
One step more and the spear goes.
The spear thrusts — that reaches far.
I jab at your legs from behind the shield.
I sweep the shaft to knock you aside.
I give half a step and thrust again.
Shield strikes first, spear follows.
That thrust used my whole body.
I stab your shield to weigh it down.

lines.zh: 矛尖蹭着你的护甲滑开。
lines.en: The point skids off your armor.
I roar, then strike.
The shaft's shock numbs my palm.
I miss; snow sprays my face.

lines.zh: 我把矛尖往下压，挑你脚背。
lines.en: I drive the point low at your instep.

lines.zh: 这一记是给死去的兄弟的。
lines.en: This one is for a fallen brother.

lines.zh: 我肩膀前送，矛根抵住腰。
lines.en: I drive my shoulder in, spear braced at my hip.
The blow lands; I retreat behind the shield.
The ship has beached. Nobody move.
I walk out of the snow mist.
This land is ours now.
I plant the shield upright in the snow.
Whoever moves first gets the spear first.
There is blood on the wind.
The snow squeaks under my boots.

lines.zh: 家乡太远了，远过这片雪。
lines.en: Home lies far beyond this snow.
I count the arrivals. Not many.
Spear in hand, I do not fear the cold.
This timber would build a ship.
I rest my hand on the shield's rim.

lines.zh: 你们这儿，缺个说规矩的人。
lines.en: You lack someone to set the rules here.
I read the sky first, then the faces.

lines.zh: 落雪不碍事，我照样看得见。
lines.en: Falling snow is no trouble; I still see.

lines.zh: 我把酒囊晃了晃，是空的。
lines.en: I shake my flask. Empty.
No one welcomes me. Better that way.
I raise the spear in salute.
I brought ten men. And you?

lines.zh: 这一趟，总得带点东西回去。
lines.en: This voyage must bring something home.
Fire singes my beard; I smell it burning.

lines.zh: 摔下来时，雪救了我一半。
lines.en: The snow took half the fall for me.

lines.zh: 海水灌进喉咙，又冷又咸。
lines.en: Seawater floods my throat, cold and salt.
The blast tears the shield from my grip.

lines.zh: 一支箭插在我的盾面上。
lines.en: An arrow stands quivering in my shield.

lines.zh: 邪门的咒语，我握紧护身符。
lines.en: Witchcraft — I clutch my charm.
Hunger has emptied my arms of the oar.

lines.zh: 雷神发怒了，我伏低身子。
lines.en: The thunder god is angry; I crouch low.
No snow underfoot, no ground at all.
